paragraphs.text: Lothar Lovisason was the son of the Balduvian chieftain Lovisa Coldeyes , born in the first year of the Thaw of Dominaria .
Like his mother, Lothar was massive, muscular, and blonde, and commanded respect from his warriors. He wore a brilliant red cloak that billowed like a sail.

Lothar was born in the year after Lim-Dûl's Battle , during which his mother Lovisa Coldeyes , who participated in the battle, had been pregnant. 20 years later, Lothar met Jodah and Jaya Ballard when they revisited the site of the battle. Lothar would go on to fall in love with Alexandrite , the daughter of Darien the Great, and thus stand as one of the founders of the fledgling nation of New Argive .
